author: IShowSpeed
text:
THE EYES OF GHANA (Full Film)
IShowSpeed presents this love letter to cinema, in which 93-year-old Chris Hesse, Kwame Nkrumah’s personal cinematographer, races against blindness and time to save over 1,000 films that reveal the hidden origin story of African independence.

Executive produced by Barack and Michelle Obama. Directed by two-time Academy Award® winner Ben Proudfoot.
